name: co2_tank_ideal_gas
title: CO2 in a 200 L tank: real-gas mass and ideal-gas error (exercise)
summary: Teaching exercise for carbon dioxide in a 200 L tank at 35 °C and 2 MPa. The model computes the real-gas mass, the mass from volume(CO2), the percentage error between those two masses, and a second ideal-gas specific volume from the gas constant.

verification.summary: Against the stored solution of R1_E2_2022.EES, compare_solution.py --ees-units reports: 13 common variables, 5 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 0. The maximum it prints is 1.00e+00 on erreur and on x_CO2. T stays 308.15 K; the tool rewrites it to 35 °C. volume(CO2) follows the real equation of state, so m_gp equals m (7.591476 kg); EES ideal-gas m_gp is 6.871023 kg.
verification.reference: EES stored solution in R1_E2_2022.EES (13 variables, EES X10.836), compared with compare_solution.py --ees-units
verification.notes: Largest relative difference printed by compare_solution.py --ees-units is 1.00e+00, tied on erreur and on x_CO2 (both unrounded 1). T prints 8.86e-01: the equation window stores 308.15 K and the model keeps 308.15 K; the tool subtracts 273.15 and compares 308.15 with 35. v_gp and m_gp print 9.49e-02. EES volume(CO2) is the ideal gas (v_gp = 0.02910774677 m^3/kg, m_gp = 6.871023084 kg, erreur = -9.492063815 %). CoolSolve volume(CO2, T=35 °C, P=2e6 Pa) returns the same specific volume as volume(CarbonDioxide), 0.02634533708 m^3/kg, so m_gp = m = 7.591476222164 kg and erreur = 0. The real-gas mass itself prints 1.96e-05 (EES m = 7.591624971 kg). v_gp2 from r_CO2*T/(p/1000) prints 4.54e-06 (0.02910830651 m^3/kg against 0.02910817423 m^3/kg). x_CO2 is 0; EES stores 100, the flag the original comment uses for a state that is not two-phase. CoolSolve quality() is clamped to [0, 1]. At 35 °C and 2 MPa the state is gas (critical temperature 30.98 °C). MCO2 is 44.0098 kg/kmol against 44.01 (4.54e-06); r_CO2 follows and stays inside rtol. 0 iterations with .initials and 0 without. The warning Did you mean 'CO2'? is cosmetic; CO2 is unchanged. The warning that t=35 looks like Fahrenheit is the intended argument T-273.15, read as 35 °C.
